\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 193-196 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R201-first-pass-words-from-chapters-193-196}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a pond and a mine.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a teacher, a lawyer, a soldier, a tailor, a barber
  \item a washerman, a cook, a driver, an engineer, a writer
  \item a poet, a painter, a singer, a player, a leader
  \item a minister, a king, a queen, a servant, a thief
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A teacher? (\textbf{\hi{अध्यापक}}, \emph{adhyāpak}.) A lawyer? (\textbf{\hi{वकील}}, \emph{vakīl}.) A soldier? (\textbf{\hi{सिपाही}}, \emph{sipāhī}.) A tailor? (\textbf{\hi{दर्ज़ी}}, \emph{darzī}.) A barber? (\textbf{\hi{नाई}}, \emph{nāī}.) A washerman? (\textbf{\hi{धोबी}}, \emph{dhobī}.) A cook? (\textbf{\hi{बावर्ची}}, \emph{bāvarcī}.) A driver? (\textbf{\hi{ड्राइवर}}, \emph{ḍrāivar}.) An engineer? (\textbf{\hi{इंजीनियर}}, \emph{injīniyar}.) A writer? (\textbf{\hi{लेखक}}, \emph{lekhak}.) A poet? (\textbf{\hi{कवि}}, \emph{kavi}.) A painter? (\textbf{\hi{चित्रकार}}, \emph{citrakār}.) A singer? (\textbf{\hi{गायक}}, \emph{gāyak}.) A player? (\textbf{\hi{खिलाड़ी}}, \emph{khilāṛī}.) A leader? (\textbf{\hi{नेता}}, \emph{netā}.) A minister? (\textbf{\hi{मंत्री}}, \emph{mantrī}.) A king? (\textbf{\hi{राजा}}, \emph{rājā}.) A queen? (\textbf{\hi{रानी}}, \emph{rānī}.) A servant? (\textbf{\hi{नौकर}}, \emph{naukar}.) A thief? (\textbf{\hi{चोर}}, \emph{cor}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 197-201 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R201-second-pass-words-from-chapters-197-201}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a class and an examination.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a class, an examination, a lesson, practice, a mark
  \item a word, a sentence, a meaning, knowledge, science
  \item history, mathematics, a crow, the heart, a bone
  \item skin, a state, a capital city, a border, an island
  \item a desert, a valley, a waterfall, a pond, a mine
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A class? (\textbf{\hi{कक्षा}}, \emph{kakṣā}.) An examination? (\textbf{\hi{परीक्षा}}, \emph{parīkṣā}.) A lesson? (\textbf{\hi{पाठ}}, \emph{pāṭh}.) Practice? (\textbf{\hi{अभ्यास}}, \emph{abhyās}.) A mark? (\textbf{\hi{अंक}}, \emph{aṅk}.) A word? (\textbf{\hi{शब्द}}, \emph{śabd}.) A sentence? (\textbf{\hi{वाक्य}}, \emph{vākya}.) A meaning? (\textbf{\hi{अर्थ}}, \emph{arth}.) Knowledge? (\textbf{\hi{ज्ञान}}, \emph{jñān}.) Science? (\textbf{\hi{विज्ञान}}, \emph{vijñān}.) History? (\textbf{\hi{इतिहास}}, \emph{itihās}.) Mathematics? (\textbf{\hi{गणित}}, \emph{gaṇit}.) A crow? (\textbf{\hi{कौवा}}, \emph{kauvā}.) The heart? (\textbf{\hi{दिल}}, \emph{dil}.) A bone? (\textbf{\hi{हड्डी}}, \emph{haḍḍī}.) Skin? (\textbf{\hi{त्वचा}}, \emph{tvacā}.) A state? (\textbf{\hi{राज्य}}, \emph{rājya}.) A capital city? (\textbf{\hi{राजधानी}}, \emph{rājdhānī}.) A border? (\textbf{\hi{सीमा}}, \emph{sīmā}.) An island? (\textbf{\hi{द्वीप}}, \emph{dvīp}.) A desert? (\textbf{\hi{रेगिस्तान}}, \emph{registān}.) A valley? (\textbf{\hi{घाटी}}, \emph{ghāṭī}.) A waterfall? (\textbf{\hi{झरना}}, \emph{jharnā}.) A pond? (\textbf{\hi{तालाब}}, \emph{tālāb}.) A mine? (\textbf{\hi{खदान}}, \emph{khadān}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
